theorem three_disjoint_perfect_subsets (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] [SeparableSpace X]
  (A : Set X) (hA : IsClosed A) (hunc : ¬ Set.Countable A) :
  ∃ F : Fin 3 → Set X,
    (∀ i, F i ⊆ A ∧ Perfect (F i) ∧ (F i).Nonempty) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (F i) (F j)) := by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hDn, hDA⟩ :=
    exists_perfect_nonempty_of_isClosed_of_not_countable hA hunc
  obtain ⟨D₀, D₁, h₀, h₁, hdisj⟩ := hD.splitting hDn
  obtain ⟨E₀, E₁, hE₀, hE₁, hEdisj⟩ := h₀.1.splitting h₀.2.1
  
  have hE₀D₁ : Disjoint E₀ D₁ :=
    Disjoint.mono hE₀.2.2 (le_refl _) hdisj
  have hE₁D₁ : Disjoint E₁ D₁ :=
    Disjoint.mono hE₁.2.2 (le_refl _) hdisj
  
  let F : Fin 3 → Set X := ![E₀, E₁, D₁]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem three_disjoint_perfect_subsets (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] [SeparableSpace X]
  (A : Set X) (hA : IsClosed A) (hunc : ¬ Set.Countable A) :
  ∃ F : Fin 3 → Set X,
    (∀ i, F i ⊆ A ∧ Perfect (F i) ∧ (F i).Nonempty) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (F i) (F j)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hPperf, hPne, hPsub⟩ :=
    exists_perfect_nonempty_of_isClosed_of_not_countable (C := A) hA hunc
  
  obtain ⟨P0, P1, h0, h1, hd01⟩ :=
    Perfect.small_diam_splitting hPperf hPne (ε := 1) (by norm_num)
  
  obtain ⟨P10, P11, h10, h11, hd1011⟩ :=
    Perfect.small_diam_splitting h1.1 h1.2.1 (ε := 1) (by norm_num)
  
  have h0sub : P0 ⊆ A :=
    h0.2.2.1.trans hPsub
  have h10sub : P10 ⊆ A :=
    (h10.2.2.1.trans h1.2.2.1).trans hPsub
  have h11sub : P11 ⊆ A :=
    (h11.2.2.1.trans h1.2.2.1).trans hPsub
  
  have hd010 : Disjoint P0 P10 := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hx0 hx10
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hd01 hx0 (h10.2.2.1 hx10)
  
  have hd011 : Disjoint P0 P11 := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hx0 hx11
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hd01 hx0 (h11.2.2.1 hx11)
  
  have hd100 : Disjoint P10 P0 := hd010.symm
  have hd110 : Disjoint P11 P0 := hd011.symm
  have hd1110 : Disjoint P11 P10 := hd1011.symm
  
  let F : Fin 3 → Set X := fun i =>
    if i = 0 then P0 else if i = 1 then P10 else P11
  
  have hFpair : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (F i) (F j)) := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [F]
  
  refine ⟨F, ?_, hFpair⟩
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> simp_all [F]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem three_disjoint_perfect_subsets (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] [SeparableSpace X]
  (A : Set X) (hA : IsClosed A) (hunc : ¬ Set.Countable A) :
  ∃ F : Fin 3 → Set X,
    (∀ i, F i ⊆ A ∧ Perfect (F i) ∧ (F i).Nonempty) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (F i) (F j)) := by
  obtain ⟨V, D, hV, hD, hAD⟩ :=
    exists_countable_union_perfect_of_isClosed hA
  have hDA : D ⊆ A := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hAD]
    exact Or.inr hx
  have hDne : D.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hn
    have hDe : D = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn
    apply hunc
    rw [hAD, hDe]
    simpa using hV
  obtain ⟨D₀, D₁, hD₀, hD₁, h01⟩ := hD.splitting hDne
  obtain ⟨E₀, E₁, hE₀, hE₁, hE01⟩ :=
    hD₀.1.splitting hD₀.2.1
  let F : Fin 3 → Set X := ![E₀, E₁, D₁]
  refine ⟨F, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [F]
    · exact
        ⟨hE₀.2.2.trans (hD₀.2.2.trans hDA), hE₀.1, hE₀.2.1⟩
    · exact
        ⟨hE₁.2.2.trans (hD₀.2.2.trans hDA), hE₁.1, hE₁.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨hD₁.2.2.trans hDA, hD₁.1, hD₁.2.1⟩
  · intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [F] at *
    all_goals try { contradiction }
    · exact hE01
    · exact h01.mono hE₀.2.2 (by rfl)
    · exact hE01.symm
    · exact h01.mono hE₁.2.2 (by rfl)
    · exact (h01.mono hE₀.2.2 (by rfl)).symm
    · exact (h01.mono hE₁.2.2 (by rfl)).symm
